items.title: When rain finally does come to drylands, only some microbes in the soil 'awaken'
items.summary: In arid regions, the microbes that power threatened dryland soil ecosystems called biological soil crusts stay dormant over long periods, only "awakening" when they sense moisture from infrequent rainfall. Now, a team led by researchers at Penn State—driven by projections that those biocrusts will decline by as much as 40% in the next 45 years—found that when a dryland soil does get wet, most of the microbes in the biocrust stay inactive. It's a discovery that will inform ongoing efforts to conserve and restore biocrusts, according to the researchers.

items.summary: Cyclopia is the most severe form of a rare birth condition in which the developing brain fails to divide into two separate halves. This can also affect facial development, sometimes leaving the baby with a single eye socket in the center of the forehead and severe facial abnormalities. Most babies born with this condition either die before or soon after birth. It is so rare that it occurs in roughly 1 in 100,000 births, so finding physical evidence of it from modern times is difficult, let alone from historical ones.

BBC Sport's Ask Me Anything team explains how the Uefa Nations League works. The competition began in 2018, and the format sees each nation compete across four different divisions. Each side competes for promotion and relegation in every campaign, with the best-performing nations in the top league going on to reach the play-offs at the end of each campaign. The best-performing nations in each Nations League campaign can also strengthen their chances of qualifying for World Cups and European Championships, but cannot directly qualify for major tournaments through the Nations League alone.

Bucking recent trends, fossil fuel emissions look to be down 0.4 percent. Annual greenhouse gas emissions are much less variable, having increased fairly steadily, but many complicating factors can still muddy the picture. Sometimes those factors conspire to throw a year off the trend. It looks like 2026 will be one of those years. A new analysis led by Corinne Le Quéré at the University of East Anglia estimates that fossil fuel emissions have fallen about 0.4 percent from last year. This probably isn’t a peak that symbolizes heartening progress on climate change, though; the researchers think it’s a short-term dip driven by the war in Iran and its effect on oil prices.

Benchmark tools for generic gaming rigs could be coming soon. Valve has been collecting anonymized frame rate data from Steam players who opt in since February . Yesterday evening, the company announced it has started sharing that data on many Steam Store pages as averages and histograms for both the Steam Deck and Steam Deck OLED. Valve acknowledges that players enabling VSync or frame rate limits can bias the collected data somewhat and that the measurements don’t account for custom in-game settings that Steam Deck users may tinker with to get a game running. Regardless, Valve says it has nonetheless “found that the framerate data consolidates around relatively narrow ranges.”

Strogatz is perhaps best known in his field for his co-authorship of a seminal 1998 paper with Duncan Watts on the collective dynamics of small-world networks. He has also studied chaos theory as applied to physics, the geometry of supercoiled DNA, and the biological collective oscillators, such as swarms of synchronously flashing fireflies and crickets that chirp in unison. In 2005, Strogatz extended his study of synchronicity to the crowds that caused the wobbling of London’s Millennium Bridge .

Ole Miss football fell in the CFP rankings after a home loss to Georgia. Here's where Trinidad Chambliss and the Rebels settled Ole Miss was No. 10 in the initial poll last week, which was in the 12-team CFP bracket. The reason for the nine-place drop was a 42-7 home loss to No. 1 Georgia. There are 12 places in the CFP, with five reserved bids and seven at-large bids. Four places go to the highest-ranked conference champions. A fifth spot will be reserved for the highest-ranked non-Power 4 team. If the non-Power 4 team is outside the top 12 in the CFP poll, it means the team ranked No. 12 in the CFP poll will be bumped from the bracket. No. 24 Boise State is that team this week.

The top eight teams get byes in the first round of the expanded playoff next season. Currently, the top four teams in the 12-team playoff get a first-round bye while Nos. 5-12 play each other across four first-round games. But even though the field is bigger, the Group of Six isn't guaranteed more representation. Just one of the 23 spots will be reserved for a Group of Six conference champion. Any other G6 team will have to make it as an at-large.

The LPGA is adding more fines in addition to stroke penalties for players in 2027 for slow play The policy for the timing method and stroke penalties is the same, but more fines have been added. In the past, each time a player finished one to five seconds over the allotted time, it was a warning, and now it will be a fine in 2027. If a player finishes six to 15 seconds over, it previously was a one-stroke penalty and now a fine is added. If a player's time is 16 seconds or more over the allotted time, it's still a two-stroke penalty but now also a fine.

An audio drama workshop has brought blind and partially-sighted people together to create a new play. A box of gravel, a handful of leaves and a miniature door might not sound like the ingredients for a wedding day drama. But in a room filled with people experimenting with sounds, they are helping to bring an entire world to life. For a group of blind and partially-sighted people, an audio-based drama workshop is giving them the chance to explore performance - without relying on visual cues. Instead, they are using sound to create characters, settings and stories, building a picture in the audience's mind without showing them a single image.

The transition to electric vehicles should be moving apace, but it is not. And why? Incompetence, expedience and cowardice, says Guardian columnist George Monbiot T his is how it works. It argues that a transition would threaten jobs, or damage the national interest, or harm poor people, while what it really fears is the cost of retooling its plants or developing new protocols. The NBA approved new lottery rules in May. In May, team owners approved the new "3–2–1" draft lottery system , which will take effect by the 2027 draft. The system further flattens the lottery odds, expands the lottery from 14 to 16 teams, and includes a relegation zone that gives the three teams with the worst records worse odds at the top pick than teams that finished with the fourth-to-tenth worst records. The belief was that more teams would enter the season with the desire to compete, with some positing that the effect could be a larger middle class and a smaller gap between the teams at the top and bottom of the standings.

Letter: A reader highlights how the government’s immigration changes are affecting those who have been granted asylum and wish to apply for indefinite leave to remain I am writing as a refugee who has lived in the UK since 2007. I claimed asylum in 2007, and my appeal was allowed by the first-tier tribunal (immigration and asylum) in February 2020. However, because of Home Office delays, I did not receive my five-year refugee permission until June 2022. I applied for indefinite leave to remain in June 2025, but my application was refused because I had not completed five years from the date my refugee permission was granted. I was therefore expecting to apply again in June 2027.

For the first time since 1971, the Longhorns will wear their home jerseys on the road. UT will wear Burnt Orange at LSU, who traditionally wear white. Texas last wore its home uniform on the road against UCLA at the Los Angeles Colosseum. UCLA also wore its regular powder blue home jersey in the 28-10 Longhorns victory. Wearing your colored jerseys on the road was more common back then. But in the early 1980s, the NCAA changed the rules. In 1982, the NCAA had altered the "jersey rule," requiring teams to wear the school color jerseys for home games. LSU, who traditionally wore white at home, wore purple jerseys for all home games from 1983 to 1994.

Ukraine's Svitolina lost 6-4 6-0 in her first group match against Mirra Andreeva on Monday and made an equally poor start against Muchova. It looked as though things were getting worse for Svitolina when she took a medical timeout for a right hip injury after losing the first set, before finding herself an early break point down. However, the sixth seed saved it and then gradually wore down Wimbledon runner-up Muchova to win 3-6 6-2 6-2.

Linebacker Divine Deablo, who played with his arm wrapped against Cincinnati, was limited.

DeShon Elliott is dealing with an injury once again. The Pittsburgh Steelers’ safety popped up on Wednesday’s injury report as […] Elliott dealt with a hamstring/knee ailment for most of the first half of the team's schedule, returning to regular season action in Week 7 against the New Orleans Saints. He played about one-third of the Steelers' defensive snaps in that one, but felt good enough to take on more of an expanded role in Week 8's win over the Cleveland Browns. "I can play 80 snaps if I need to," he said before that matchup. "But, you know, that's up to the coaches and what they want my role to be. And, you know, I'm a team player."

Bachmeier also dispelled internet rumors that he sustained an injury that limited what he could do in Saturday's rivalry game at Rice-Eccles Stadium, saying he is "feeling good physically" and accustomed to taking hits in every game. "You gotta be tough," he said. "… We got Baylor on Saturday, and we got to bounce back. … The locker room (mood) was tough. But yeah, we got a team coming in here on Saturday, and we got to be ready to play."

Outside of quarterback takedowns, Lewis also knows how to stop other skill players behind the line of scrimmage, totaling a team-high 10 tackles for loss. Even when he isn't sacking quarterbacks or making momentum-changing tackles, Lewis still finds ways to impact the outcome of a game. Barcelona are of course fresh off a crucial three-point haul on Sunday, when they put Diego Simeone's Atlético Madrid to the sword by two goals to one in Spain's capital. The aforementioned De Jong was forced to make do with a place on the bench at the Metropolitano, before ultimately being introduced during the 2nd-half.

JJ McCarthy reflects on his Minnesota connections while focusing on his Giants career. McCarthy previously played for Minnesota after the Vikings selected him 10th overall in the 2024 NFL Draft. However, he joined the Giants in September and is now focused on his new team. Speaking to reporters Wednesday, McCarthy admitted he had not followed the developments involving his former team. "To be honest with you, no. I mean, obviously there's one of the 32 teams out there, but all I'm focused on is Giants and who we're playing that week," McCarthy said.
